# 5X Hub – Features

- Welcome, Changelog, Credits

## Movement

## Aim

- **Hitbox Expander** (always active, size slider, wall check)

## Anti Aim
- **Spin Bot** (Spin/MoonWalk)

## Exploits

- Fake ping, random high ping, manual slider

### Auto Headshot
- **V1** (head raycast), **V2** (any part raycast)

### Teleport & Spin
- **Auto Teleport To Enemies**
- **Spin Around Target** (orbits while teleport active)

### Experimental
- **Blink Kill** (blink behind, fire, blink back)

### Weapon & Build
- **Infinite Ammo**, **Instant Fortify**, **Auto Fortify**
- **Equip Weapon** dropdown, **Equip MAC-10**

### Enemy Marker
- **Auto Marker** (crosshair ping), **Nearest 3 Marker**

### Notification Spam
- Rainbow text every 0.15s

### Jumpscare
- Teleport to looked-at enemy, delay slider

## Visuals
### Player ESP
- Skeleton, Tracers, Name, Health, Tool, Rainbow ESP

### Other Visuals

## Utility
- Camera FOV override, teleport up/down, infinite zoom, respawn
- Anti Kick, Gun Spoofer, Claim All Promo Codes

## Settings
